columns.$description: Columns in the emoji picker grid. The same number is in the code as EMOJI_COLUMNS (frimousse takes it as a number); the test emoji/emojiTokens.test.ts compares both.

size.$description: Height of an emoji cell in the picker grid (31 px at a 13 px root); the width is a share of the row (1 / columns).
Emoji glyph size in a picker cell (19.5 px).

width.$description: Width of the picker panel above the 'emoji' button in the input field (312 px at a 13 px root); in the chat window the picker takes the content width.

height.$description: Height of the picker panel: fixed, so the panel does not jump when the 'Recent' section appears and disappears during a search (351 px).
